The '''Spotlight sloth''', or '''spot-light sloth''', or '''Dagobah swamp sloth''', was a large furry mammal native to the swamps of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. The sloth was covered in a waterproof greenish-brown fur. They were so named because of the blue [[Wikipedia:Bioluminescence|bioluminescent]] patches beneath the leathery skin on their hairless chests. These "spotlight" patches, when revealed, were used to induce plants and fungi to unfold and/or burst. The sloth would then use its small paws to quickly stuff food in to its toothless mouth.

[[File:SpotlightSloth-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A pair of sloths.]]

Spotlight sloths favored fresh, succulent flowers along with the berries of the [[Lahdia plant/Legends|lahdia plant]], but willingly ate other plants if necessary. In turn, sloths were preyed upon by Dagobah's [[Knobby white spider/Legends|knobby white spiders]]. One stab of the spider's venomous stinger could knock out an unlucky sloth.
